quality_gate: OCR recognition quality thresholds were waived by the user; retain failures and measures without tuning.
limitations: Scanned table cells are not automatically reconstructed as analytical datasets. OCR page text is readable evidence; explicit accepted digital table datasets support arithmetic.
Layout PDF table extraction uses local geometry, without a Docling model download.
Parent-child section parents are first section chunks with smaller indexed leaves, not full-section duplicates.
PPTX and HTML embedded images are reported but not OCR processed.

microvm.execution: configured Nexus-style microVM, DuckDB DECIMAL aggregation, exported result CSV, session cleanup
